title: Verify project prerequisites and access
description: Verify that required database access, MCPs, service documentation, environment variables, and login/test users are available before implementation begins.
acceptanceCriteria: `PROJECT_ROOT/.env.local` exists with placeholder entries for every required environment variable name listed in the PRD: PORT, SESSION_SECRET, GALAXY_SEED, DB_DRIVER, DB_PATH, DATABASE_URL, SYSTEM_INSTANCE_COUNT, WS_PATH
Real secret values are not written to the PRD, task specs, repository, logs, or chat
The user has manually filled SESSION_SECRET (and DATABASE_URL if using Postgres) in `.env.local`

SQLite storage works with no external service (better-sqlite3 installs and a test db file can be created at DB_PATH); live Postgres is NOT available in this sandbox — recorded as a user-approved proceed gap (PG parity via Drizzle dual-driver unit tests)
MCP servers configured in `.mcp.json` (playwright, context7, sequential-thinking) are available for the implementing agent, or gaps are recorded with a user-approved proceed decision
Required service documentation links are accessible: three.js, Fastify, ws, Drizzle ORM, better-sqlite3
Test users require no setup (callsign-only auth); e2e will use disposable callsigns TEST-ALPHA / TEST-BRAVO

steps.description: Read prerequisite requirements from the PRD
steps.details: Open `.agent/prd/PRD.md` and review the `Prerequisites and Access` section. List required database access, MCPs, service docs, environment variable names, test-user needs, and open gaps (no live Postgres; headless WebGL perf limits).

Confirm `PROJECT_ROOT/.env.local` exists and contains all eight variable names from the PRD (PORT, SESSION_SECRET, GALAXY_SEED, DB_DRIVER, DB_PATH, DATABASE_URL, SYSTEM_INSTANCE_COUNT, WS_PATH). Add any missing names with placeholder values only (e.g. `TODO_FILL_MANUALLY`). Never write real secret values.

steps.description: Confirm local secret values are filled manually
steps.details: Ask the user to confirm SESSION_SECRET contains a real random value (64+ chars). Never print, store, commit, or copy the actual value into generated files or chat. DATABASE_URL may stay a placeholder unless Postgres is used locally.

Confirm Node 22 + npm are available. Verify `better-sqlite3` can be installed (npm install dry-run or in a temp dir) and a db file can be created at `./data/drift.db`. Confirm no live Postgres exists and record the user-approved proceed decision for the PG gap.

Confirm the MCP servers in `.mcp.json` (playwright, context7, sequential-thinking) are reachable for the implementing agent. Confirm the documentation links in the PRD (threejs.org/docs, fastify.dev/docs, github.com/websockets/ws, orm.drizzle.team, github.com/WiseLibs/better-sqlite3) are accessible and sufficient.
Confirm no real test accounts are needed (callsign-only). Document that e2e will create disposable callsigns TEST-ALPHA and TEST-BRAVO at runtime. No passwords or secret values exist or are stored.

technicalNotes: This task gates implementation. Do not start dependent feature tasks until required prerequisites are verified or explicitly approved as gaps.
Secrets must stay local and must never be committed or copied into PRD/task artifacts.
Open gaps with proceed decisions: (1) no live Postgres in sandbox; (2) headless CI WebGL is functional-only, perf verified on reference hardware.
